description: The 1986 Clarendon Press reprint with corrections of the standard survey of the manuscript transmission of the Latin classics, edited by L. D. Reynolds with contributions from P. K. Marshall, M. D. Reeve, R. H. Rouse, R. J. Tarrant, M. Winterbottom and others. Hardcover in dark blue cloth with gilt spine lettering and the Oxford device, in the original pale blue dust jacket. A very good copy in a good jacket: the jacket has a small tear and light chipping at the upper left corner of the front panel, light soiling and a faint crease to the rear panel, and noticeable tanning along the flap folds and turn-ins. Internally the text is clean and unmarked throughout and the binding is tight and square, with light toning and a few small spots to the top edge; a previous owner has signed and dated the front free endpaper in ink (16.9.86), with a small pencilled shelf notation alongside.
